answer.finalSql: SELECT date_trunc('month', "date") AS "month", SUM("daily_new_deaths") AS "deaths" FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a" WHERE year("date") = 2022 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
answer.assistantText: This shows the share of US deaths in each month of 2022, using the US deaths dataset and the same monthly totals as the "Monthly US deaths in 2022" chart on this dashboard. I did not change the saved chart itself; this is a new pie view of the same numbers.
